verifier: blind Claude agent re-implementation from the brief only; comparison computed by compare_independent.py (agent verification, not human)
ambiguities: Rows with null match_num would give 'nan' in game_id (none expected; printed count of nulls).
Window lower bound inclusive (d_m >= d-1095), upper strict (d_m < d), in whole days from YYYYMMDD dates.
Null round/tourney_name -> sentinel string, null best_of -> -1 sentinel, so nulls match only nulls.
Value when ne>0 but tr is NaN: formula gives NaN (cannot occur since the event matches are a subset of tour matches).
Tour rate computed via cumulative integer-valued sums (exact for 0/1 values), weights via direct pairwise 0.5**(days/548).
A token set that is empty (score with only RET etc.) is not OK since max(ws,ls)!=need.
Output interleaved winner row then loser row per match in read order; floats written with 17 significant digits.
best_of parsed numerically (strings like '3' or '3.0'); missing -> not OK.
match_num/ids parsed via float->int to handle '123.0' formatting.
note: new round x best_of columns only; earlier columns keep their TENNIS_tennis2.json MATCH
